text: A visitor opens Excalidraw. The VibeCheck SDK reports semantic events only: no text, no screenshots, no recording.
They want an image of their diagram. Share opens live collaboration instead. Save to writes a file nobody else can open. Two detours, then a help request.
Jev reads the window: friction, a wrong path, recovery after help. Above the gate, it becomes a research candidate.
Now the same task as a study, with a real person thinking out loud. Actions and speech land on one clock, no screen recording.
A verified audio archive, a transcript, and the exact actions behind it. Evidence, not opinions.
